hooks.prompt: Check if hub-guide MANDATORY skills are being applied where relevant: engineering-principles, clean-code, clean-architecture, testing, error-handling, security, git-workflow, api-design. If the assistant is using evidence from codebase/docs instead of guessing, and is not violating any of these principles, respond: {"ok": true}.
